title: AreaJam Full Desktop Walkthrough
ctaTagline: Find your tribe. Match with musicians today.

scenes.headline: Find your tribe. Match with musicians today.
scenes.narration: Welcome to AreaJam, a free web app built to help local musicians find players to jam with without wading through silent classifieds.

scenes.headline: Filter instruments, genres & keywords fast
scenes.subline: Play clips directly on the deck
scenes.narration: Filter players by instrument, genre, or keyword, listen to linked clips right on the swipe card, and use arrow keys or touch gestures to match.

scenes.headline: Switch cities or start a board in your town
scenes.narration: Prefer a full grid view? Open Browse Players to inspect everyone in your metro, or create a fresh board for your own hometown.

scenes.headline: Gear lockers, wall notes & jam requests
scenes.subline: Everything you need to vet the vibe
scenes.narration: Every musician gets a customizable page with their rig breakdown, linked performance reels, rehearsal availability, and direct match chat.

scenes.headline: Pull videos straight from your YouTube handle
scenes.narration: In Profile and Studio, enter your YouTube handle to import your videos, list your gear, preview your card, and go live in about a minute.

scenes.headline: Find your tribe. Match with musicians today.
scenes.narration: Visit areajam dot com in any browser and drop your city and instrument in the comments so nearby players can find you.
